newsitem.title: UK: BFI rises nine points to 1,274 on Panamax demand.
newsitem.headline: BFI rises nine points to 1,274 on Panamax demand.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) was up nine points on Tuesday to 1,274. Strengthening Panamax demand in the North Atlantic has been responsible for the rise.

Egyptian charterers have been active from the US Gulf and Cargill are believed to have paid about $12,500 daily plus a $250,000 bonus for the Shinwa-relet Peoria, 73,000 dwt, for end-June delivery trip Japan with grain. Pan Ocean fixed Far Eastern Progress, 72,000 dwt, delivery US Gulf early July at similar levels.
The Baltic Handy index was down two to 1,024 with continuing depressed conditions in the category worldwide.
